༄༅/ /zab chos rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur gyi las rim khyer bder bkod pa ye shes mchog sbyor zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// zab chos rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur gyi las rim khyer bder bkod pa ye shes mchog sbyor zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

thabs mchog snang ba'i bdag nyid rta mgrin rgyal// shes rab stong pa'i rang bzhin wā ra hi// zung 'jug gu ru yid bzhin nor bu'i zhabs// bdag snying ze'u 'brur bkod la byin rlabs stsol// ye shes rang shar phrin las ni// nā da'i rang sgrar 'brel ba yi// smin byed seng 'o skal ldan gyi// gser gyi yol gor sbyin 'di rmad// rtsa gsum gcig dril khyad par can gyi zab chos 'di'i smin byed kyis skal ldan rjes su bzung ba la/ dbang phyogs kyi tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus bzang por dben pa'i gnas su stegs dmar por dkyil 'khor spyi mthun sgo bzhi rta babs khor yug dur khrod pad rdor me ris mtshan pa'i dbus su/ padma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog gi lte bar zla gam dmar po sgo gcig dang ldan pa'i ras bris sogs 'dzom na bkram/ ma grub na me tog dmar po'i tshom bu gtso 'khor lnga bkod pa'i khar mañdzi la bum pa so lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings dmar po kha rgyan gzungs rdor ldan pa bkod/ mdun du ka pā la mtshan dang ldan par dza gad mngar gsum sbyar ba blugs pa'i kha dar dmar gyis bkab la bzhag /g.yas phyogs su rdo rje dril bu lhan cig dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon du ḍā ma ru dang thod khrag /rgyab tu rtsa gsum gcig dril gyi gtor ma zur gsum me ri dang rtse mor rta mgos mtshan zhing zhabs su padma 'dab bzhi can kha dog dmar po la dkar rgyan mdzes tshon dar gyi gdugs phub pa bkod/ sman rag gtor gsum/ phyi mchod rnams spyi ltar dang*/ las bum tshogs gtor sogs mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par bya'o// de nas 'grub na phyi sgrub ltar mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga gsal btab la/ phyag 'tshal sogs tshang bar brjod cing thun mong gi tshogs gsog /mi 'grub na spyi 'dus ltar skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa byas nas/ 'di nyid kyi las byang tshig don dbyer med ji lta ba'i mtshams gcod nas bstod pa'i bar btang*/

bzlas pa'i skabs/ bdag nyid rta phag yab yum rigs bdag gu ru dang bcas par gsal ba'i lha gsum gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa dang*/ khyad par du rta mgrin gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'og tu hrīḥdang phag mo la ma yig ste gnyis ka dmar gsal me 'od lta bu'i yab kyi hrīḥl sngags phreng rnams g.yas skor du dmar hrom me bar 'khor ba las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor yang bdag bskyed ji lta bar skad cig gis gsal btab pa'i thugs srog gi 'od zer bdag bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas/ bdag gi sngags phreng rnams gyen du nar gyis byung ste yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs shing yum gyi gsang ba nas yab kyi gsang bar brgyud de thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka dang zhal dang sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas thugs ka nas tshur byung ba/ bdag gi thugs kar sngar bzhin phog pa'i ting nge 'dzin yengs med kyis bzla sa pa ci mang bya zhing*/ thun mjug tu dbang rdzas bum pa sogs tha dad re re la yang rnam pa rdzas de dang de'i tshul la ngo bo lha ru bskyed pa la/ bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis phog pa tsam gyis so so'i nus pa bskyed nas byin rlabs mthu ldan du gyur par mos la bzla sa pa ci 'grub bya/ stong tshigs phul/ las bum du rta mgrin dpa' gcig bskyed bzlas kyis byin brlab/ bka' srung gtor 'bul yang 'di skabs sam nam bder bya/ mdun bskyed lha tshogs gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs srog hrīḥm dang bcas pa las 'od zer bdag gi gnas so sor thim pas dbang rnams yongs rdzogs skad cig la thob par mos la gnyis med mnyam nyid chen por mnyam par bzhag /de nas slob ma rnams sgo'i phyi rol du khrus bya/ nang du 'jug pa dang ngar glud changs bu dang bcas pa la chab bran te/ oṃ bhrūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ oṃ las 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang*// trāṃ las rin chen ratna'i snod// hrīḥlas gsung dbyangs drug cu ste// āḥlas ci 'dod phun sum tshogs// so sor dga' mgu tshim byed pa'i// 'dod dgu'i yo byad chen por gyur// na mo/

dkon mchog thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pas/ der 'dir rdo rje'i slob bu rnams smin byed zab mos dkri bar byed pa la bar du gcod cing log par 'dren pa'i bgegs rigs 'khrul rtog gi rang gzugs a 'thas ji snyed yod pa thams cad/ 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i glud gtor 'dis tshims par byos la/ 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba'i mthu stobs 'od zer drag por 'khrugs pas khyed kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdul phran phye mar brlag par 'gyur ta re/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro ta ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sarba bhū ta utstsha ta ya phaṭaḥ ces yungs thun rol mo'i tsham rngam drag po sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ hrī: nga ni khro rgyal rta mgrin te: rta skad rngam sgrog bar chad sel: sku yi 'od zer mtshon cha'i gur: me ri 'bar bas phyogs mtshams gcod: ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams: rnam rtog ma rig bag chags kyis: lha dang 'dre bgegs gnyis snang yang: rnam par rtog pa bgegs yin phyir: 'dre bgegs rang gi sems las byung: sems nyid chos sku'i don rtogs na: bgegs dang bar chad ga la yod: thams cad rang grol chos sku'i mtshams: 'di las su yang 'da' ma byed: shūn+ya tā rakṣa hūm̐: zhes kun rdzob me mtshon khro chung gi srung 'khor dang*/ don dam rnam rtog mtshan ma'i bgegs ye stong ka dag gi lta bas bsrung ngo*// me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab la/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rtsa gsum chig dril rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur ba ste/ de'ang sngon gyi dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bka' don log par spyad pa'i rnam smin gyi rang gzugs ma traṃ ru dra drag po 'jigs byed dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba srid pa gsum la dbang byed cing 'gro ba rnams dmyal thag gcod pa'i stobs ldan shin tu ma rungs pa zhig byung ba/

de 'dul byed gnyen po rgyal ba rnams bka'i bgros te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs thugs rje drag por khros pa dbang chen padma he ru ka nyid du mnga' gsol bas/ de nyid chos kyi dbyings las 'bar ba chen po'i gar gyis bzhengs te ru dra dbang phyug chen po drag shul stobs kyis tshar bcad/ gzugs phung dur khrod chen po brgyad/ zag pa nang khrol thams cad rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi sman mchog /rnam shes bstan srung chen po ma hā kā lar byin gyis brlabs/ ru dra'i chas dang bran g.yog thams cad dpal gyi chas dang phyi nang gi 'khor du mdzad nas/ dbang gi dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul nas nyid las mi gzhan pa'i padma'i sems dpa' dang dbang gi lha mo bde byed ma la sogs pas zhus pa'i ngor/ padma dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud sde grangs med pa gsungs pa thams cad zhu ba pos bsdus te ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams la gnyer du gtad pa las/ rtsod pa'i dus mthar slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang gu ru padma 'byung gnas sogs la bka' babs te/ de dag gis rgyud la brten pa'i gdams ngag gi dgongs 'grel sgrub thabs las tshogs mtha' yas pa mdzad cing de la brten nas rgya bod gnyis su grub pa'i skyes bu'ang ji snyed cig byon pa las/ skabs su babs pa 'di ni/ dbang chen rta mchog rgyal po dang tha dad mi mnga' ba'i gu ru bde ba chen po padma sam bha bas/ bde gshegs spyi dril rngog ma le brgan 'bar ba'i rgyud chen gyi yang bcud rta mchog gtsug gi nor bu'i rgyud don man ngag snying por phyungs te/ bod yul du rje 'bangs sum cu rtsa brgyad la gnang zhing khyad par nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i chos skal du gnyer gtad mdzad nas phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du rten mchog dam rdzas khyad par can dang lhan cig

/kong yul nyang lung ljon pa'i nags tshal gyi rked pa snyal mo lha'i brag 'od dpag med rang byung du gsal ba'i gnas su rgya bdun gyis btab pa/ phyis dus la babs pa'i tshe nyang ban chen po'i thugs sprul rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag me 'bar gyis gdug pa'i mi dang mi ma yin zil gyis gnon pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa chen po dang bcas te spyan drangs nas skal ldan rnams la rim par spel ba ste/ lung byang las/ de 'dra'i dus kyi tha ma la: zab chos spyod pa skal pa bzang: dbang lung thob pa tsam gyis kyang: phal cher rang bzhin grol bar 'gyur: gter rdzas khyad 'phags mjal tsam gyis: las ngan sdig sgrib dag par 'gyur: dam rdzas kha la myang tsam gyis: ye shes rtsa kha 'byed par 'gyur: ces dang*/ gzhung las/ bar chad bgegs 'dul dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: 'brel tshad don ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'gyur: zhes dbang bskur thob pa tsam gyis rnam par grol ba'i mchog la sbyor ba sogs bsngags pa don dang ldan pa'i smin byed zab mo bsgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇḍal phul du gzhug / bla ma rta phag yid bzhin nor bu rtsa gsum kun 'dus su gsal ba la dad mos kyi gdung shugs bskyed de gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma bla ma rin po che: dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid: bdag cag 'khor ba'i btson rar tshud: 'di la thugs rjes gzigs mdzod la: dbang mchog dam pa bstsal du gsol: lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i lan du dam tshig gi skal pa'i nus stobs dri zhing gnang ba'i skabs dbye ba la gsan par zhu/ ho: bu khyod su yin ci zhig bya: gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'jug pa'i skal ldan las 'phro can: brgya lam de ni res 'ga' tsam: rtsa gsum dam tshig bsrung nus sam: zhes dris pa'i lan du rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig thams cad srog la babs kyang mi nyams par bsrung snyam pa'i dam bca' dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos/

bdag ni rigs kyi bu gcig pu: sngon sbyangs las 'phro can yin no: rtsa ba'i dam tshig bdag gis bsrung: thugs rjes dgongs la dbang bskur zhu: lan gsum/ srid mtshor bying ba'i skye dgu thams cad thog ma med pa nas ma rig pas bsgribs te rang byung ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar ras dmar pos gdong g.yogs bcings par mos shig / ces 'bru gsum brjod la gdong g.yogs/ rang byung don gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten tu rin po che'i me tog thogs par mos shig / 'bru gsum gyis cod pan sbyin/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang gnyis su med pa rtsa gsum kun 'dus rta phag yid bzhin nor bu rang snang ye shes bkod pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i spyan sngar/ theg pa chen po'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed yang dag par len pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi: rgyud drug 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: bzod med gdung bas sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir: kun kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: zhes shwa lo ka gcig gi rjes zlos lan gsum/ gnas lugs rang bzhin gyi lta dgongs don dam yan lag bdun gyi tshul la mnyam par bzhag ste brjod pa tshig gi sgo nas gsal 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams thams cad sku gsum rang bzhin la: gnyis med klong yangs chen por phyag 'tshal lo: ma bcos mtha' bral mnyam pa nyid kyis mchod: rang sems sangs rgyas ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs rang rig ngang du yi rang ngo: 'dzin med khyab brdal rol pa'i chos 'khor bskor: 'khor 'das dbyer med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: chos dbyings lhun grub chen por bsngo bar bya: zung 'jug kun khyab bde chen mchog thob shog: sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid rang gi tshe rabs sngon nas bsgoms shing bsgrubs pa'i las 'phro gang yod kyi lhas byin gyis brlabs nas rang rig ye shes rang ngo mthong bar mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i mos gdung chen pos 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas te 'dor bar zhu/

ho: rtsa gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: rang rig snang ba'i me tog 'bul: sngon nas las kyi 'phro yod pa'i: yi dam lha la 'bab par shog: ces 'dor du gzhug / de ltar phul ba de nyid rigs kun 'dus pa rtsa gsum yongs kyi dkyil 'khor la bab pa lags pas/ de dang mthun par dbang gi mtshan yang rigs 'dus dbang chen drag po rtsal zhes pa'i ming 'dzin pa zhu/ slob dpon gyi thugs nas 'od zer gser mdog thur ma'i dbyibs can 'phros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i bag chags sgrib g.yogs mtha' dag bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod cig ho: ji ltar mig mkhan mig dbye ltar: khyod kyi ma rig ling tog ni: rig pa'i ngang du da dbye bas: rtsa gsum lha la legs par ltos: zhes thur ma'am rdo rjes gdong g.yogs bsal/ khyed cag rnams 'di lta bu'i gsang mchog bla na med pa'i chos la dad cing dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i sgor zhugs pa ni bsod nams kyi skal pa mchog rab tu gyur pa yin la/ 'on kyang 'di lta bu'i sgor zhugs phyin chad gsang mchog rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag dang bcas tshul bzhin bsrung dgos/ de ma bsrung na mnar med pa'i dmyal ba chen por ltung nas thar pa'i dus mi 'byung zhing*/ dam tshig ma nyams par bsrungs na tshe gcig bla med byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par nus pas na blang dor gyi gnad phyin ci ma log pa bya dgos so// de dag gis dbang gi snod rung du sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub/ dngos gzhi dam ye dbyer med du bsgrub cing dbang gi ye shes brtan par bya ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzad 'tshal/ sa phyogs 'di dag bde chen dbang gi pho brang ye shes 'od kyi gzhal yas khang/ slob dpon bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ khyed rang rnams kyang gdan padma nyi zla bdud bzhi'i steng du/ yi dam kun 'dus dbang chen rta mchog rgyal po sku mdog dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin cing shin tu khros pa'i nyams can/

dbu gtsug rta zhal ljang zhur sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang rin po che rus rgyan dar dpyang gis brgyan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams ldan ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i klong na zhabs 'dor thabs kyis bzhengs pa la yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog phyag mtshan rang dang 'dra bas 'khyud cing dbu gtsug phag gdong gis mtshan pa/ yab kyi dbu skra gyen du 'khyil pa'i dbus na rigs bdag gu ru yid bzhin nor bu padma sambha ba'i cha byad zhi 'dzum can/ mnyam gzhag nor bu bsam 'phel 'dzin pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang thugs kar hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa'i 'od zer dang*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor pa'i thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas 'og min bde ba can/ o rgyan sprul pa'i grong khyer/ dpal ri padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs dam bskul/ sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa dbyar gyi char sprin 'thib pa ltar byon nas/ khyed rang rnams la dam tshig ye shes gnyis med du thim pa'i mos pa dang*/ dad gus gdung ba'i shugs drag po bskyed par mdzod cig /

sbyar spos rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: ma hā gu ru tsindha ma ṇi/ ha ya grī ba/ badzra bā ra hi/ sa pa ri wā ra e ā ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ/ pheṃ pheṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dbab/ ye shes pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ kā ya bā ka tsitta badzra swā hā/ zhes dang rtsa sngags rten snying gis bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor la rab tu gnas/ dbang don dngos gzhi'i ye shes brtan cing gong 'phel bya ba'i slad du brda don mtshon rdzas dbang rnams rim par bskur ba la/ bum pa rang byung 'od gsal gyi gzhal yas khang du bum bcud gdod nas yongs grub rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor dngos su gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas sgrib pa bzhi dag /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /oṃ hūm̐/ bum pa gzhal yas khang gi nang: bum rdzas rtsa gsum lha tshogs gsal: dbang bzhi thob nas sgrib bzhi dag pa'i don: skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ: zhes bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu sbyin/ des bum dbang lus la bskur pas bskyed rim sku'i dbang thob cing*/ lus sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i sa bon thebs pa yin pas/ snang ba sku'i khyer so dang mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig la gnas par mdzod cig /bhañdza rang byung padma'i pho brang du rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyam sbyor byang chub sems su zhu ba mgrin pa nas brgyud de 'phel/ rtsa rlung thig le kun la khyab pas sgrib bral ye shes snang stong grags stong bde stong dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs par mos shig /hūm̐ ā: dus gsum don mdzad rtsa gsum lha tshogs sku: dad mos can la byin rlabs mngon sum 'byung: dag cing gsal la sgrib bral snang stong 'char:

skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ.āḥ.ā: zhes pas thod pa mgrin par bzhag cing bdud rtsi sbyin nas/ des gsang dbang ngag la bskur pas rdzogs rim gsung gi dbang thob ste ngag longs sku 'grub pa'i sa bon thebs pas grags pa gsung gi khyer so'i dam tshig la gnas par mdzad 'tshal/ rdo rje thabs bde ba chen po sprul pa'i sku dang*/ dril bu shes rab stong pa nyid chos kyi sku /dbyer med zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i brdas mtshon te nges pa'i don rtogs par gyis shig /ho: rang lus phung po lha dang lha mo'i ngang: rtsa gsum lha tshogs rigs rnams kun gyi bdag: dug gsum dag nas sku gsum lhun gyis grub: skal ldan bu mchog khyed kyis thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes rdor dril snying gar bzhag cing lag tu gtad do// des ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang mchog sems la bskur pas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug thugs kyi dbang thob ste/ yid chos skur grol ba'i sa bon rgyud la thebs pa yin pas/ dran rtog thugs kyi khyer so'i dam tshig las mi 'da' bar mdzad 'tshal/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus snang lha sku gsal la rtog med/ ngag rlung gzhom med nā da'i rang sgra /'gyu dran rang grol ka dag gi ye shes su shes nas lam du khyer bar mdzod cig /ho: bskyed rim gsal la dran 'dzin zhig: sngags bzlas chu bo'i gzhung dang mtshungs: gsal cha ma 'gags lha sngags dbang: skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: rtsa ba'i snying po'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzad pa zhu/ phreng ba spel la snying po dang dbyangs gsal dang rten snying rnams kyi rjes zlos byar gzhug / snying po sngags dbang ma thob par bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod la mi dbang zhing*/

byas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung la/ sngags dbang ngag la thob phyin chad bzlas pa sngags kyi nus pa bde blag tu 'byung zhing lha myur du 'grub par 'gyur bas na dus rtag tu yi dam rtsa ba gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub la 'bad par zhu/ thabs shes yab yum mtshon pa'i phyag mtshan gyis dbang bskur bas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad rang dbang med par lus dang grib ma ltar 'khor zhing zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thams cad thogs med du 'grub par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ho: snang ba dbang sdud ḍā ma ru: dngos grub 'byung ba'i thod khrag 'di: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo'i srog gi rten: dbang mchog dam pa thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hri ya: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas lag pa g.yas su ḍā ma ru dang g.yon du thod khrag gtad la/ deng phyin chad dam tshig la nyes ltung med pa dang*/ dus bzang rnams su tshogs gtor gyi mchod pa la brtson dgos pa lags/ de ltar sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang lnga rim can du bskur pas rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs kyi byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o// gtor ma 'di nyid rtsa gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus gu ru yid bzhin nor bu'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa dngos su gsal ba la/ khyed rang rnams snying khong rus pa'i gting nas mos gus kyi shugs bskyed de gsol ba 'debs pa lhan cig tu mdzad pa zhu/ las rdor gyis spos dang dbang gtor thogs/ slob dpon gyi dbyangs snyan ḍā dril bcas/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs so: skal ldan byin rlobs dbang bskur stsol: longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol ba= skal ldan byin rlobs= 'gre/ sprul sku rta phag yab yum la gsol= skal ldan byin rlobs= rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag me 'bar la gsol= skal ldan byin rlobs= drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol= skal ldan byin rlobs=

kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bu la gsol ba 'debs so: skal ldan byin rlobs dbang bskur stsol: ces gsol ba btab nas/ gtor ma gu ru yid bzhin nor bu dang tha mi dad pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis/ gu ru nyid 'od phung du ltems kyis zhu nas khyed rang rnams la gnyis med du thim pa'i mos pa rtse gcig mdzad par zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'gro ba 'dren mdzad 'od 'bar thod phreng rtsal: o rgyan yul byon 'gro kun lam sna 'dren: rgya gar yul byon thos bsam sgron me sbar: bod kyi yul byon gdug pa ma lus btul: sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas: thugs dam dgongs pa dad can rnams la 'beb: smin grol dbang dang gdams pa ma lus kun: skal ldan bu mchog 'di la bstsal du gsol: 'chi med sku yi dbang mchog bstsal du gsol: 'gag med gsung gi dbang mchog bstsal du gsol: 'khrul med thugs kyi dbang mchog bstsal du gsol: mi brjed gzungs kyi dbang mchog bstsal du gsol: dam pa chos kyi dbang mchog bstsal du gsol: 'dod 'byung nor bu'i dbang mchog bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas gtor dbang bskur zhing rol mo bsgrag /me tog gi char dbab bo// de ltar dbang rdzas spyi bor zhugs pas bum dbang thob/ lus sgrib dag /bde gshegs sku'i rdo rje 'grub/ lus lha bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob/ mgrin par zhugs pas gsang dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag /bde gshegs gsung gi rdo rje 'grub/ ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob/ snying gar zhugs pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid sgrib dag /bde gshegs thugs kyi rdo rje 'grub/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob/ lte bar zhugs pas tshig dbang rin po che thob/ sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag

/bskyed rdzogs gnyis med bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa yin pas de ltar nges shes bskyed mdzod/ de nas dbang thams cad kyi snying po'i yang snying rig pa rtsal gyi dbang ngam/ don dam ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar bya ba ste/ 'di ni kun rdzob rdzas kyi dbang la ltos ma dgos pa rang byung ye shes rang ngo sprod pa'i dbang yin pas na/ khyed rang rnams kyang lus gnad lta stangs dang ldan pa'i ngang nas sems 'di nyid sngar 'das kyi rjes su mi 'brangs shing ma 'ongs pa'i sngon bsu mi byed/ da lta'i rig pa dgag sgrub bzo bcos mi bya bar/ rang gsal rjen pa'i ngang du 'jog par mdzod cig /phaṭa/ ces brjod pas slob ma 'gyu rtog gi bar mtshams chod nas shes pa gsal dwangs rjen par 'char ba de la 'di ltar ngo sprod par bya'o// kye/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams 'di ltar shes par gyis shig /phyi gzugs brnyan du snang ba'i rtsa ba gsum ni mtshon byed kyi brda dang dper bstan pa yin la/ nang rang gi sems stong gsal zung du 'jug pa nyid mtshon bya don gyi rtsa ba gsum yin te/ de'ang sems nyid ka dag 'dus ma byas pa'i ngo bo stong nyid spros pa dang bral ba ni byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma/ de'i rang mdangs 'od gsal sgrib g.yogs med pa chos thams cad gsal la ngos bzung dang bral ba ni dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam/ stong gsal zung 'jug gi rang rtsal rnam par rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan ci'ang snang zhing gang yang 'char ba ni phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro ste/ gsum ka don la tha dad du grub pa med cing gzhan las ma byung ma skyes par rang rig thig le nyag gcig gi klong du rdzogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ rang sems rang ngo shes pa'i tshe don dam pa'i rtsa ba gsum gyi dbang dang byin rlabs yongs rdzogs su thob pa yin pas/ dbang don mthar thug pa 'di nyid dang por thos pas go

/bar du nyams su myong*/ mthar rtogs pa'i ye shes rang zhal mjal ba la brtson par mdzod cig /bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas nam mkha' gang ba'i me tog gi char 'bebs shing bkra shis pa'i bden tshig brjod pas/ dbang don gyi ye shes ma skyes pa bskyed/ skyes pa brtan cing nyams med gong du 'phel ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rten snying bzlas pa'i 'bru 'thor la shis brjod rgyas par bya/ de rnams kyis sprul pa'i rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho'i 'khor los sgyur ba 'ja' tshon snying po'i zab gter rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur zab mo legs par grub pa yin pas sogs brjod la/ dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag maṇḍal spyi ltar bya/ slob dpon gyis tshogs mchod skong bshags rjes 'brel bcas/ dkyil 'khor la gtang rag mchod bstod nongs bshags phul/ gshegs bsdu bsngo smon shis brjod sogs rang gzhung dang spyi mthun rgyas par bya'o// snang ba yi dam lha yis grub gnyis ster// stong nyid khyab bdag bla mas byin rlabs stsol// zung 'jug mkha' 'gros las bzhi lhun gyis grub// 'phral dang yun du dge legs dpal 'bar shog /ces khyer bde'i slad du 'ja' tshon snying po'i zab gter chos bka' mtha' dag gi smin grol gdams pa'i bka' babs thob pa padma gar dbang 'chi med bstan gnyis gling pas shrī de bī ko ṭi'i snying po tsa 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //
